name: SM_Burn_Hole_B_PR

textures.channels: tangent normal, OpenGL (green up; flip green on import)
R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic

material_exception: unique BC/N/ORM bakes private to this asset (not a row of ART_STANDARD.md section 2): remains are one-off set pieces
pivot: bbox centre in X/Y, lowest point at z = 0; in Blender +X is screen right and +Y screen up (north) for a yaw_from_sprite row
dresses: a hole burnt into the ground, slightly drawn out
known_weaknesses: A flat alpha-tested card 6 mm above the ground: the outline is a hard cut-out, nothing soaks into the ground or stains grass blades, and it does not follow uneven ground. Depth is painted for the fixed play camera (the far wall of the hole, the plank ends, the dark below): from the side or from the north it is flat.
